featured_reviews.name: Hirali Sanghani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the jewellery store, and I had an absolutely wonderful experience. From the moment I walked in, the hospitality was exceptional, and I felt genuinely welcomed.
Ruchika Ambekar and Riddhi Upadhyay were especially helpful. They patiently listened to what I was looking for, guided me through options, and helped me customize a piece to exactly match my vision. Their expertise and kindness made the entire process so much easier and more enjoyable.
A big thank you also to Pratik and Asha (from the orders department) — your support in making sure I got exactly what I wanted was invaluable.
I also want to highlight the warm and caring service in the store’s pantry, particularly Rekha ji, who served food with such love and graciousness. It was a small touch, but it made the visit feel even more special.
Overall, I highly recommend this jewellery store — not just for the beautiful pieces, but for the outstanding customer service. I will definitely be coming back!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hey Hirali, we appreciate your kind words and are delighted to hear about your wonderful experience with our team. Ruchika Ambekar, Riddhi Upadhyay, and the support from Pratik and Asha truly embody our commitment to excellent customer service. We offer a wide range of jewelry options for our customers, and it’s heartwarming to know that you found the perfect piece with their assistance. We’re also thrilled that you enjoyed the thoughtful service in our pantry. Thank you for recommending us, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon!

featured_reviews.name: pratima das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience ever! I had a wedding in the family and hence rented out 2 jewellery sets. But due to some family issues had to switch to real gold jewellery. I requested the owner prior to the function if the rental could be cancelled for one set only and did not ask for any refund infact requested if I could purchase something with that same amount. The owner was very very rude and denied straight forward. Even though I was willing to keep the other rental set. I explained my situation but he did not even want to listen. I assured him that I don't want the money but if I could purchase something else for another family member instead. It gets very difficult to manage all this during a wedding and hence expected some kind of understanding. Rather than understanding the situation he kept emphasizing on his policies. I know businesses have policies but I was still giving him a business with the other set that I rented out. It's terrible to see how you get treated as a customer. I would request you all to please think twice before giving them any business. The shop just opposite this store shree Ambika choice center is much better and helped my mom to make the adjustment as she rented her jewellery with them. They were so accommodating with all her requests even though it was last moment. It's just a matter of understanding  and the way you treat ur customers if u want them to keep coming to you. As a matter of fact I did not get the money back for something i didn't even pick up. And this place goes on to looting people's money. Beware of such fraudsters as we are all working very hard to earn. STOP RUNNING A SCAM AND BE GENUINE IN HELPING YOUR CUSTOMERS RATHER THAN LOOTING THEM!  If u earn money this way it won't fulfill ur dreams but definitely spoil ur name in this business.
Pathetic service , Rude owners  and pathetic experience is all I have to say about this place. Use ur money wisely they don't deserve your business!

featured_reviews.name: nikhil sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly disappointing experience with this store. They charged me premium making charges for very average design work, which was already upsetting. To make things worse, the diamonds on the ring started falling off the very next day! This ruined our engagement event and caused so much embarrassment. On top of that, the staff was extremely unprofessional and rude in their behavior when I reached out to address the issue.

I would strongly advise others to think twice before trusting them for such important occasions.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Divya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fraudsters in every sense. Firstly they will not tell you their standard rate for making charges, the sales associates like a fish market will quote any amount and then pretend that you are being given some discount, which is not really the case. Next, there are no display boards for gold rate of the day and they will quote 24k rate for 22k jewellery. When you check this yourself and confront them, they'll present a dramatic show of how they have charged a very nominal making charge.
When you first visit, they will all be super nice, show you all possible designs. Then when you've placed the order, paid half the amount and go to collect the product, it turns out to have a clear defect. Now, once you have highlighted this, nobody will come attend to you. I was just waiting there and the staff will not attend to you even if they are idle.
It was a painful exercise of follow-ups for me, after that to finally get the product. My bad luck, I had an immediate requirement and happened to like this particular design. Would never ever visit again or recommend to anyone
